content.title: Frontier AI developers must be 'liable for the things their products do': Autodesk CEO
content.description:
Discourse has been circulating recently on AI safety, fears, and regulation, with commentary from Nvidia (NVDA) CEO Jensen Huang, Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) CEO Dario Amodei, and even President Trump.

Autodesk (ADSK) president and CEO Andrew Anagnost sits down with Market Catalysts host Julie Hyman to share his thoughts on the importance of holding Big Tech accountable.
